title: semigroup
description: A magma whose operation is associative — the generated object of `associating` a magma. Associativity is the local conjunct that the `associating` morphism adds to magma.

associativity.description: (a ∗ b) ∗ c = a ∗ (b ∗ c) for all a, b, c — parentheses may be dropped
